title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.
bodyHtml: §288-8  Penalty.  Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both. [L 1941, c 186, §6; RL 1945, §7435; RL 1955, §160-147; HRS §288-8]
